Episode 256. Morganiel (4)
Five days.

Considering the situation outside, it was not a short amount of time. It was enough time for the mortal world to be destroyed if beings like Kelliark, the Demon Army, and Malugia were to run rampant all at once.
'Kelliark and Malugia, for now, it's a relief that they are both still alive. Whatever happens in the mortal world within these five days, they will have to keep each other in check.'

He must not be crushed by a sense of debt. And in Jin's opinion, the probability of them coming to find this place was higher than the probability of them causing trouble in the mortal world. That is, if they recognized Solderet's arrangement as a dangerous card.

Jin composed himself and looked at Chiron. In the first place, the speed at which the coalition had rendezvoused with the expeditionary force in this trip to the Black Sea and even subjugated Morganiel was much faster than expected.

“The changes you have brought to the mortal world seem greater than the changes this Black Sea is undergoing due to Morganiel's death. Not just a fleet, but a portable long-range communicator? I suddenly feel old.”

Chiron was admiring the development of the mortal world that Jin and the coalition had achieved. Chiron, fiddling with the communicator as if it were a novelty, was a sight that Jin and his siblings had never imagined.

“Not at all, Father. It is a pity that we cannot immediately inform the family of the fact that you have completed your lifelong wish. Because communication from the Black Sea to the mortal world is impossible.”
“Heng, you feel old? Compared to me, you're no different from a newborn, yet you say such things, Chiron.”
“It is the same even when compared to me.”
“Van, what is your age?”
“I cannot tell you. Just know that I am over three hundred.”

Murakan, Van, Chiron. The three of them were already treating each other as comfortably as if they were old friends. For the coalition members, especially for the knights of Runcandel, it was a novel sight in many ways.
“You have both lived long. But, you must live longer.”
You must live longer; it was a single phrase that contained a lot.
Chiron Runcandel, before he had overcome his demonic transformation, had intuited that he would, in the end, meet his death in the Black Sea when he reached the end of his destiny.

However, from the moment his demonic transformation disappeared, he did not consider death at all. He had a strong will to surely survive, return to the family, and spend the rest of his life in atonement.

Atonement for the fact that, in his absence, the members of his family, especially Jin, had shouldered all the burdens of Runcandel. For instance, he wanted to make Runcandel a better family, a family that was stronger and more solid than before, but also one that could be joyful.
He thought that only that could be atonement for the dark times of the past, and that feeling was still valid.
“Of course, we must.”

“Yes, what a good world it would be if only the Demon Army and Malugia didn't exist. Ah, there's the Ganestos too. Anyway, if we just get rid of those bastards, there will be no more of these terrible wars in the world until we disappear. I'm going to live happily with Strawberry Pie, making and eating strawberry pies together. Aish, at that time, I'll be able to stop taking care of that kid, right?”
“...Wait, Murakan. Are you seeing Gilly?”

“Ah, you wouldn't have known. Keuk keuk, even in the midst of war, love blooms. Even if it's you, if you treat Gilly carelessly, it won't be fun at all. Got it? You just try saying things like the laws of Runcandel or whatever, I'll just whack you.”
“I shall give you my blessing.”

For a while, a lighthearted and friendly conversation continued. Above them, in the scenery of the Black Sea that had changed into a beautiful primeval forest, the flying fortress and the golden fleet that adorned the sky were glittering.
The feeling that a horrific nightmare, where the world could suddenly end in a single moment, might just pass by.
However, the reality was not so. They could not waste the five days resting.
“This should be enough of a rest. Now, let's slowly get moving.”
It wasn't just Ameris who had work to do.
The coalition had to scout the changed terrain and also check out the path that Morganiel had intentionally opened in advance.
Even if this was the deepest domain of the Black Sea, there was no law saying a sudden enemy attack couldn't begin. They must not let down their guard.

“Youngest, if Solderet's arrangement truly benefits us, in my opinion, the probability of the enemies coming to find this place is high. I don't think Kelliark Zipple or Malugia would fail to notice a change of this magnitude in the Black Sea.”
“My thoughts are the same. They will surely notice the change, so the key is how much they have recovered.”
Five Genesis Knights, plus the flying fortress Laprarosa and the Golden Fleet.
Even if Kelliark and Malugia were beings who had completely broken the scale, it was a reckless move for them to come here in a wounded state.
“Furthermore, we must also be conscious of Rokia Ganesto. She seemed desperate to obtain the arrangement, so she will try to interfere in some way.”
“Let's check out the path that Morganiel opened for now. Youngest, you shall take command of the forces.”
“Is that alright?”
“I am the patriarch of Runcandel, not the leader of the coalition. You are the one who has led them until now, so it is only logical.”
Chiron patted Jin on the shoulder.
Even before he had reached the state of a Genesis Knight, Jin had indirectly received Chiron's acknowledgment. On the day he had met him in the inner world, and when he had received the letter.
“Appointing you as the Young Patriarch is one of the best things I did while leading the family.”
However, it was the first time he was hearing such words face to face.
“Something is surging up from within my chest, Father.”

“Do not think so preciously of the praise of a father who was only cruel and severe. Your Runcandel of the future will shine incomparably to the time when I led it. When all the fighting is over, I will support you.”
“Ugh, I think I'm going to cry.”
“I'm not crying, so you shouldn't cry either, sister.”
“Tsk, you're so great.”
“While we are scouting the destination, the flying fortress Lafrarosa will be on standby at its current location, and the fleet will disperse and conduct reconnaissance flights.”
The Genesis Knights began to move.
The moment they passed through the bright yellow trees, a beautiful trail appeared. The falling leaves seemed to dance as they fluttered in the wind.
No threat was felt at all. Still, the Genesis Knights did not increase their speed and moved with caution.
They also repeatedly looked back.

They were concerned that the path might suddenly change, like in the Black Sea of the past. But such a thing did not happen even after an hour had passed, and it was the same when two hours had passed.
Because the trees were not very tall, the figure of the flying fortress Lafrarosa, which was holding its position behind them, did not disappear.
How much longer did they walk like that.
The five of them finally stopped their steps before a single 'line.' It was a black line that was perfectly straight as if cut by a sword, dividing the domain.
“The real thing starts from here.”
“Hmm, is it okay to cross this? Isn't it going to suddenly move us to another region or cut us off from this area?”
Even if one had reached the state of a Genesis Knight and obtained insight, one could not see through everything. Moreover, this was the Black Sea, and the one who had opened the path was Morganiel.
“Aura, magic, shadow energy. It is a line made of an energy that does not correspond to any of the three.”
“The color is similar to shadow energy though, Father.”
Van, Murakan, Chiron, and Luna spoke in turn. Their gazes naturally shifted to Jin, who was staring at the black line as if lost in thought.
“It is not shadow energy. But it is strangely familiar, Murakan. Do you not feel anything special?”
“You say the energy that makes up this line is familiar?”
“Yes. It is not shadow energy, but it is as comfortable as shadow energy. No, it is an energy that feels even more comfortable than spiritual energy.”
“What? If so, that means it's related to something, but why is it only you who feels it? More than that, more comfortable than shadow energy... is that possible?”
A deeper, thicker, and darker energy.
That was how Jin was feeling the black line. Soon, Jin knelt on one knee and touched his finger to the black line, and a fist-sized ripple of darkness spread out, as if ink were bleeding.
“...It is difficult to explain, but it is not a harmful power to us.”
The other Genesis Knights also began to touch their fingers to it just like Jin. However, the line did not react differently to their energies.
“Is it something that Solderet prepared for the kid? Hmm, I'm a bit disappointed that I can't feel anything.”
“I think it is safe to enter.”
With Jin in the lead, all the Genesis Knights took a step across the line together.

At that, the scenery changed in an instant. When they looked back, the brilliantly colored domain of Morganiel had disappeared as if hidden by a curtain, and the inside of the line was just a dark space like the middle of the night.
However, if they took a step back again, the darkness would immediately disappear and the domain of Morganiel would reappear.
“It's a kind of subspace. Whether to go in further, or to stop for now. How about everyone follows Brother Jin's opinion?”
“This unknown power is clearly favorable to me. There must be something like the entrance to the arrangement inside, so it would be best to advance further and see it with our own eyes.”
“Alright, let's go.”
Once they crossed the black line, the other Genesis Knights could not make out the path at all. Because to them, it was just a dark space.
However, to Jin, it felt as familiar as if he were strolling down a main road in broad daylight. Naturally, the Genesis Knights ended up following Jin, and it did not take long to reach the end.
“This must be the entrance to the arrangement.”
Jin said, stopping his steps.
“We can't see anything.”
The Genesis Knights looked at Jin's back. Jin was silent for a while with his palm on the entrance that was only dark.
Then, suddenly, Jin flinched and opened his mouth.
“...I think I know what is inside.”
On Jin palm, which was touching the unseen entrance to the arrangement, a night-black energy was shimmering.
